abilities.name: iron-fist
abilities.effect: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.

kanto.flavorText: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

original-johto.flavorText: To increase the strength of all its punch moves, it spins its arms just before making contact.

hoenn.flavorText: A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

original-unova.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

updated-unova.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

kalos.flavorText: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working toward a world championship. This Pokémon has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Punches in corkscrew fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall like a drill.

swsh.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
